title: Kīhei former institute property housing redevelopment
summary: The county is now choosing a developer to receive a sublease to redevelop the interim housing property, after the housing department issued an RFP in March. County money would keep the interim program, which first housed wildfire survivors, running through February of next year. In 2024, the state bought the Kīhei former hotel for $45 million to become teacher housing, workforce rentals and pre-kindergarten classrooms.

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The county is picking a developer, who will get a sublease to develop the interim housing property.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The housing department issued an RFP in March to redevelop the interim housing property.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The housing director said the interim housing facility included wildfire survivors when it was first filled.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: County money would keep an interim housing program that first housed wildfire survivors running through February of next year.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The administration will check the property's community plan designation and report back before Friday's vote.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The $45 million to buy the property is state money appropriated by the legislature.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Units would be split into thirds for households at 80%, 100% and 120% of the area median income (the middle income for the area).
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Tenants would have to recertify their income every year.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The state plans to open the Kīhei building to wildfire survivors who are not eligible for FEMA reimbursement.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Teacher households are those with a full-time pre-K, primary or secondary teacher at a public or accredited private school.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The administration said the project helps meet an ongoing need for housing local workers can afford.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The council is set to consider approving the agreement this Friday.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: A state-bought former hotel in Kīhei would become teacher housing, workforce rentals and public pre-kindergarten classrooms.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
